title: "01_load"
format: html
editor: visual

## Aim of the file

Read the raw data from _raw/ and write them as tsv files in the data/ folder,
which prepares them for the data cleaning step.

## Load Libraries

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
#| message: false

patients  <- read_tsv(here("_raw", "data_clinical_patient.txt"), comment = "#")
samples   <- read_tsv(here("_raw", "data_clinical_sample.txt"),  comment = "#")
mutations <- read_tsv(here("_raw", "data_mutations.txt")) |>
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.x))))        # drop empty rows

```

## Data Check

```{r}
dim(patients)
dim(samples)
dim(mutations)
```

## Write Data

```{r}
write_tsv(patients,  here("data", "01_dat_load_patients.tsv"))
write_tsv(samples,   here("data", "01_dat_load_samples.tsv"))
write_tsv(mutations, here("data", "01_dat_load_mutations.tsv"))
```
